node.statement: Lefschetz-Hopf application. The map f of node 1.7.1 is a self-map of a finite polyhedron with the finite fixed set {h(breve-e)}, and its fixed point lies in a maximal simplex. Thus lem-topology-lefschetz-hopf gives L(f)=ind(f,h(breve-e))=1; using L(f)=L(breve-sigma) yields L(breve-sigma)=1 under the singleton hypothesis.
